newsitem.title: USA: DuPont Merck refutes Barr charges.
newsitem.headline: DuPont Merck refutes Barr charges.

text.p: DuPont Merck, a joint venture between Merck Co and Dupont Co, said on Tuesday that it asked the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to tighten generic approval standards for a generic anti-coagulant drug to ensure patient safety.
Barr Laboratories is seeking FDA approval to market Warfarin Sodium tablets, a generic version of DuPont Merck's Coumadin anti-coagulant.
DuPont Merck was allegedly trying to delay Warfarin's approval to protect Coumadin and had asked the FDA to change the product's bioequivalence guidelines, Barr said.
